title: Remove the Free plan's 2-computers-in-use cap
description: Builds on 0001: also nulls liveSessionsLimit. In the cua-home WASM `relayUsage.view`, that turns the 2-of-2 cap into `Computers in use 2`, drops the limit notice, and makes the plan card say `No limit on remote use`. The relay still meters; this is the display and client-prompt layer only. Works on the macOS WebUI bundle and the Windows Electron resources/web bundle.
notes: Applied by default after 0001. The 2-of-2 string itself is rendered by the native/WASM cua-home view; this patch removes the relay-usage cap the view reads.
